data.name: Hina
data.gender_notes: Hina is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic ḥinnāʾ, 'henna'. Its root is ح-ن-ا (ḥ-n-ā). A common Muslim female name. Hina is a Arabic name meaning “Henna; (also) fragrance”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hina expresses “Henna; (also) fragrance”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hina total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
